Prove ARCH_MODE 0 is frozen K1, ARCH_MODE 1 is M803 K8, and ARCH_MODE 2 is frozen equal-bandwidth K1x8.
Prove analyze, elaborate, check_design, check_timing, TIM-209/OPT-150 gate, and then compile_ultra ordering in the frozen Tcl.

Execute NO_EDA_FULL_PATH_SELF_TEST in a clean HOME-absent environment pinned to the target runner and candidate hashes. Require all admission/contract/provenance/jq/JSON/exact-file/tool/library gates to pass and exit before resource preflight, license query, attempt, or DC.
Confirm canonical and attempt identities remain absent after every check.
